description: This is a Java interface file for OrderFacade, defining methods related to order processing, calculation, shipping, validation, and retrieval within an e-commerce system.

classes.name: OrderFacade
classes.description: Java interface defining the contract for order management operations in an e-commerce system.

methods.name: initializeOrder
methods.description: Initializes a new order for a given store, customer, shopping cart, and language.

methods.name: refreshOrder
methods.description: Refreshes or updates an existing order with latest store, customer, shopping cart, and language information.

methods.name: calculateOrderTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total summary for an order, used in website and API contexts.

methods.name: processOrder
methods.description: Validates and processes an order, optionally with a payment transaction.

methods.name: initEmptyCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new, empty customer object for anonymous users.

methods.name: getShipToCountry
methods.description: Retrieves list of countries to ship to for a given store and language.

methods.name: getShippingQuote
methods.description: Calculates shipping quote based on customer, cart, order, store, and language.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Creates a shipping summary object from a shipping quote, store, and language.

methods.name: validateOrder
methods.description: Validates an order, possibly checking constraints and returning messages.

methods.name: getReadableOrder
methods.description: Fetches an order in a human-readable format by order ID, store, and language.

methods.name: getReadableOrderList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of readable orders for a customer or store with pagination.
